sources: Huang, Yeomans, Brooks, Minson & Gino (2017), It Doesn't Hurt to Ask: Question-Asking Increases Liking, JPSP 113(3) – Study 3: 110 speed daters, 1,961 four-minute dates; a higher rate of follow-up questions was associated with more second-date agreements (correlational).

Kardas, Kumar & Epley (2022), Overly shallow?: Miscalibrated expectations create a barrier to deeper conversation, JPSP – 12 experiments, 1,800+ participants; deep conversations with strangers were less awkward and more connecting than expected.

Eastwick, Finkel, Mochon & Ariely (2007), Selective versus unselective romantic desire: Not all reciprocity is created equal, Psychological Science – 156 speed daters; unselective desire was not reciprocated, desire for one partner above others was reciprocated.
